text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you describe the involuntary movements you've been experiencing, such as whether they are tremors, jerks, or restlessness? Also, have you recently started any new medications, particularly for psychiatric issues?

speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old college student. The patient is here for a follow-up appointment. He was recently diagnosed with schizophrenia and started on risperidone approximately 2 months ago. Reports a significant improvement in psychiatric symptoms since the start of treatment.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience a constant feeling of inner restlessness or an uncontrollable urge to move, such as pacing or shifting your weight? Are these movements more noticeable when you are sitting still or trying to relax?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Inability to remain still, persistent feeling of restlessness. I also have Frequent fidgeting, Repetitive crossing and uncrossing of legs, Pacing.

speaker: Doctor
text: Based on your description of inner restlessness and the inability to remain still, these symptoms are classic for akathisia, a common side effect of risperidone.
